{{Vanilla|Archaeology}}
'''Archaeology''' works as in vanilla ''Minecraft'': suspicious sand and suspicious gravel are brushed to reveal an item. [[Matcha Flavoured]] changes the vanilla archaeology loot tables and adds suspicious gravel with new tables to its own structures. The pack's brush is the [[Archeologist's Brush]].

Many tables can give a [[clay fetish]] (through the table <code>matcha:archaeology/statues</code>) or one of the [[sacred texts]].
